sources.snippet: Integrity note: MRM is not the original Zhang et al. model. It is the open reimplementation MultiResoModel-Simple (Hieu-Thi Luong), which we trained ourselves on PartialSpoof (see TRAINING.md). The paper attributes it accordingly.

sources.title: partial-spoof-cross-domain-audit-reproducibility/README.md at main ...
sources.snippet: Reproducibility Package "How Trustworthy Are Partial Spoof Detectors? A Cross-Domain Operational Audit" (IJCB 2026) Reproduces every number in the paper from the raw detector score outputs, and documents the exact detector checkpoints used. Built 2026-06-10; self-contained for the analysis/reproduction path (no GPU, no datasets needed).

sources.title: Robust Localization of Partially Fake Speech: Metrics and Out-of-Domain ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we use two SSL-based fake speech localization systems to examine various aspects of evaluating and improving robustness in out-of-domain scenarios. Specifically, we utilize the Multi-resolution Model (MRM) 1, introduced alongside the PartialSpoof dataset [4], and the Coarse-to-Fine Proposal Refinement Framework (CFPRF) 2 [8].
